template: You are on a new Odoo quotation form with Customer '{{v1}}' already set and an empty order line. Pick a NON-CONFIGURABLE product from the catalogue (a plain product with no variants — do NOT use Office Chair / {{v3}} which opens a '{{v4}}' modal; if a configurator modal appears, cancel/close it and try a different product). Choose an actual option from the product autocomplete dropdown, set Quantity to 3, then Save the quotation (avoiding any configurator modal). Report: (a) the product name, (b) the unit price on the line after save, (c) the untaxed amount shown after save, and (d) the quotation's order reference/name if one is assigned. Do not wait for network idle.

target.selector: div > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > ol > li > a
